ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Minnesota Day Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of day care fraud in Minnesota, including the amount of taxpayer funds misused and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: How much taxpayer money has been misused in Minnesota day care fraud?
Who are the individuals and organizations involved in the scandal?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread misuse of taxpayer funds and hold those responsible accountable. I will investigate further and follow the money to uncover the extent of the scandal.
